remarks: Welcome to Lockhaven Estates Patio Homes – A Peaceful Retreat You'll Love to Call Home! This home is completed and is Move in Ready! Nestled in a quiet and serene community, Lockhaven Estates offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. From the charming covered front porch that enhances curb appeal to the high-quality finishes inside, every detail has been carefully selected. Step into the dream kitchen featuring a 6-foot peninsula Breakfast bar with quartz countertops, Homecrest cabinetry with soft-close doors and drawers, walk in pantry and luxury vinyl plank flooring that flows seamlessly throughout most of the home. Unwind in the bright and inviting sunroom. The perfect place to relax with a good book next to your fireplace. The sunroom is highlighted cathedral ceiling that adds to the open, airy feel with Pocket French Doors separating the Sunroom from the Living room. The primary suite serves as a true private retreat, offering a spacious walk-in closet, primary bath with double-sink vanity, ceramic tile shower. Enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle with landscaping and snow removal included in the homeowners’ association.  Taxes are TBD.
